decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is a multi-model line that fits the firm's announced organic expansion, so management stays committed even though it was only mentioned on the website and its visibility is low.
The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own web page and is central to the organic and new-format strategy, so this public commitment and the investment already made favor persisting with it.

The premium sharing salami snack line has several models and its own page, which shows substantial investment and visible commitment, so any weak early results would likely be blamed on launch-phase factors.
